command:
import copy,json,re
from pathlib import Path
import pyte
base=Path("/Users/wangxuyang/Code/t3code/pi-ext/.scratch/worktrees/pi-animation/.tmp/final-verification-66-20261029")
class Screen(pyte.Screen):
    main_state=None
    def set_mode(self,*modes,**kwargs):
        if kwargs.get('private') and 1049 in modes:
            if self.main_state is None:
                self.main_state=copy.deepcopy({k:v for k,v in self.__dict__.items() if k!='main_state'});self.reset()
            modes=tuple(m for m in modes if m!=1049)
        super().set_mode(*modes,**kwargs)
    def reset_mode(self,*modes,**kwargs):
        if kwargs.get('private') and 1049 in modes:
            if self.main_state is not None:
                columns,lines=self.columns,self.lines;self.__dict__.update(self.main_state);self.main_state=None;self.resize(lines=lines,columns=columns)
            modes=tuple(m for m in modes if m!=1049)
        super().reset_mode(*modes,**kwargs)
results=[]
for root in sorted(base.glob('working-*')):
    if not root.is_dir():continue
    f=json.loads((root/'screens.json').read_text())['finished']
    s=Screen(120,40);stream=pyte.Stream(s);raw=(root/'terminal.ansi').read_bytes()[:f['rawBytes']]
    stream.feed(re.sub(r'\x1b_.*?\x1b\\','',raw.decode('utf8'),flags=re.S))
    view='\n'.join(v.rstrip() for v in s.display)
    r={'entrance':root.name,'source':str(root/'terminal.ansi'),'byteEnd':f['rawBytes'],'matchesCapturedText':view==f['text'],'synchronizedFrameComplete':raw.rfind(b'\x1b[?2026h')<raw.rfind(b'\x1b[?2026l'),'workingAbsent':'Working' not in view,'rateAbsent':not re.search(r'(?:≈[\d.]+|--) t/s',view),'goalPresent':'Goal:' in view,'cursor':{'x':s.cursor.x,'y':s.cursor.y},'text':view}
    assert all(r[k] for k in ['matchesCapturedText','synchronizedFrameComplete','workingAbsent','rateAbsent','goalPresent']),r
    assert r['cursor']==f['cursor'],r
    results.append(r)
assert len(results)==6,len(results)
(base/'ansi-replay.json').write_text(json.dumps({'passed':True,'layer':'Offline ANSI replay; not physical terminal pixels','results':results},ensure_ascii=False,indent=2)+'\n')
print(json.dumps({'passed':True,'entrances':len(results),'allFinalFramesHidden':True,'allGoalRowsPresent':True}))
